params.body:
The Stocklist platform offers a second B1 read beside its figures: `photos_sample`, a sample of vehicle photos with remove.bg's cut-outs and the dealer backgrounds, for the trial of the platform's own cut-out service (stocklistdealer-eu/platform #1006 and #1007, which adds the tool). It is not an aggregate, so the platform asks for its own kind, `stocklist.photos_read`.

This names that kind in the 30-day read word for the Stocklist project, next to `stocklist.read`, with a label that says what it opens: real photos with their plates and the dealer backgrounds, never a garage's name or anything about people. `Grants` lists it under "Reads a live system".

A word issued before this change does not carry the kind, so the platform refuses the sample on it until the owner admits reading again. That re-admission, on the passkey, is the explicit yes the widening needs; no new button and no change in the app.

Tests: `ReadLayerTest` and `AppAdmitOnKeyTest` pin the B1 kinds for Stocklist as `[stocklist.read, stocklist.photos_read]`; the widening test still refuses a token that adds the repair kind. Full suite: 726 tests, one known worktree-only failure (`BuildStampTest`).

Elixir needs nothing: a read never passes the gateway.
params.title: Name stocklist.photos_read in the 30-day read word for Stocklist
